#  MachineSeries Stay organized with collections  Save and categorize content based on your preferences. 

A collection of VM machine types. Each series includes all machine generations and processor variants for that machine type. For example, `MACHINE_SERIES_N` includes N4 (Intel), N4D (AMD), N4A (Axion), and older generations like N2 and N2D.

This enum is not frozen; new values may be added in the future.

Enums  
---  
`MACHINE_SERIES_UNSPECIFIED` | Should not be used.  
`MACHINE_SERIES_E` | Cost-optimized machines such as E2.  
`MACHINE_SERIES_N` | General-purpose machines such as N4.  
`MACHINE_SERIES_C` | Performance-optimized machines such as C4.
